hypothesis: A session-aware, report-only adaptation of the canonical 1m/5m/15m detector may provide causal regime context for v51 HIP-3 routes without fabricating continuity across market-session gaps.
decision: Do not expand the live canonical collector or attach HIP-3 regime preferences to routing. Preserve provider-native HIP-3 telemetry and defer a distinct report-only shadow until its session reset, warmup, restart persistence, source identity, and non-routing isolation contracts are preregistered and tested.

analysis.root_cause: The exclusion is intentional. The canonical classifier rejects any non-exact cadence, while HIP-3 instruments can contain session gaps. The v51 poller does fetch causal 1m candles for both HIP-3 symbols, but the current collector filters them before classification.
analysis.direct_expansion_failure_mode: Adding HIP-3 symbols to the existing supported-symbol set would make their evaluations eligible for attach_regime_preferences and would expose the live poll cycle to a ValueError when retained candles cross a session gap.
analysis.partial_telemetry_value: The current session supports causal 1m and 5m states and component diagnostics, but it cannot support the complete canonical 1m/5m/15m identity because no 15m row has completed the 60-bar warmup.
analysis.economic_value: Unproven. Current exact SP500 and SPCX v3 economics remain right-censored and sparse, so adding a regime label cannot yet establish route expectancy or justify an entry/exit filter.
analysis.current_safe_alternative: Retain provider-native breakout, EMA21/55, fresh pre-close L2 pressure, condition-proximity, MFE/MAE, stop, profit-lock, and maximum-hold telemetry while exact lifecycles resolve.

candidate_shadow_contract.required_session_policy: reset on every observed non-1m cadence gap without forward fill
candidate_shadow_contract.required_warmup_policy: UNKNOWN until each timeframe satisfies its frozen causal warmup
candidate_shadow_contract.required_restart_policy: persist exact source/cursor identity or explicitly rewarm; never reuse unlabeled state across a gap or process run
candidate_shadow_contract.required_source_policy: completed venue candle identity must remain distinct from provider L2-pressure identity
candidate_shadow_contract.required_acceptance: row-for-row causal replay, gap and restart falsifiers, no import by routing or execution controllers, and a prospective coverage report

limitations: The frozen prefix covers one contiguous intraday segment and does not include an observed session gap.
The 15m canonical context is entirely warmup-incomplete in the frozen segment.
No exact v51 SP500 or SPCX long lifecycle exists, and only one SP500 short plus two SPCX shorts have been observed.
Canonical crypto classifier parameters have not been economically validated for HIP-3 indices.
A session-aware shadow would increase observability but could still have zero incremental predictive value.

decision_detail.recommendation: Defer implementation until exact route lifecycles resolve or the current session reaches full 15m warmup; if pursued, build a separate authority-none session-aware shadow rather than modifying canonical_regime_symbols.
decision_detail.why_now: The TUI and lifecycle journals expose missing HIP-3 regime context, but a naive fix would create a live poll failure mode and silently broaden routing inputs.
decision_detail.alternatives_considered: Expand the existing canonical symbol set, forward-fill session gaps, lower warmup, use only 1m/5m states, create a separate session-aware shadow, or retain provider-native telemetry.
decision_detail.expected_upside: A future isolated shadow could measure whether session-aware regime context explains entry quality, exit giveback, or side asymmetry without risking live behavior.
decision_detail.main_risks: Invented continuity, insufficient warmup after restart, classifier transfer failure across asset classes, future data leakage, accidental routing attachment, and post-hoc filtering of sparse trades.
decision_detail.validation_completed: Frozen-prefix checksum reconciliation, exact cadence audit, direct current-classifier replay, warmup coverage counts, source-code contract trace, and routing call-path inspection.
decision_detail.validation_still_required: An observed session-gap fixture, restart persistence fixture, prospective full-warmup coverage, exact decision-time alignment to provider evaluations, and economic attribution after resolved both-side lifecycles.
decision_detail.success_metrics: Zero noncausal rows, zero routing/execution imports, explicit UNKNOWN during warmup, exact gap resets, complete restart provenance, and measurable incremental explanatory value versus provider-native telemetry.
decision_detail.failure_or_rollback_triggers: Any route/risk behavior change, any classification across a gap, any unlabeled warmup reuse, any identity mismatch, or no incremental information after a preregistered forward window.
decision_detail.confidence_level: High confidence that direct canonical expansion is unsafe and semantically wrong; medium confidence that an isolated shadow is technically feasible; low confidence that it improves profitability.

evidence.role: immutable audit that freezes the exact cohort ledger prefix used for the cadence replay

falsifier: Update this disposition if a distinct session-aware shadow proves exact gap/reset/restart isolation and produces fully warmed, causal HIP-3 regime rows; update the economic priority only if those rows add stable explanatory or predictive value in a preregistered resolved-lifecycle window.
single_highest_value_next_investigation: Resolve xyz:SPCX:517022750282 and xyz:SP500:516695933154 under their frozen v51 contracts, then compare entry pressure, exact costs, MFE/MAE, profit capture, final exit, and any fully warmed session-aware context without changing live parameters.
